Shengyu Co., Ltd. in Taiwan, Yodogawa Shengyu (Hefei) High-Tech Steel Sheet Co., Ltd. in China and PCM PROCESSING(THAILAND)LTD. in Thailand are in charge of manufacturing and selling steel sheet products overseas, and Yodoko Shoji, together with Takada Kozai Kogyo, is in charge of sales and processing in Japan. People, communities, the future.” and has formulated the long-term vision “BLOOMING VISION 2035” toward 2035, the year of its 100th anniversary.
